goal: Iske baad aap project demo ki tayyari kar sakenge, apna code taqriban do minute mein samjha sakenge, demo wale din se pehle galat input se test kar sakenge, aur jo concepts use hue hain unke baare mein viva ke sawalon ke jawab de sakenge.
warmup: Cricket match se pehle team nets mein practice karti hai. Koi bhi practice ke baghair asal game nahi khelta. Demo bhi aisa hi hai: ek dost ke saath ek dafa poora chala kar dekhein, mushkil gendon (galat input) ko try karein aur apne shots (apna code) jaan lein. Project grade ka 15% hai, is liye pur-sukoon, tayyar demo mehnat ke laiq hai.
definition: Demo aap ke chalte hue project ka chhota live show hai, jis ke baad sawal hote hain. Viva zubani sawalon ka session hai jis mein instructor aap ke code ke baare mein poochta hai. Boundary test un values ko check karta hai jo bilkul ijazat ki hadd par hon, masalan jab marks 0 se 100 tak hone chahiye to 0, 100 aur 101. Checklist aisi list hai jise aap tick karte jate hain taake kuch bhoola na jaye.
howItWorks: Course notes ki checklist follow karein: problem ko ek ya do sentences mein batayein, main menu dikhayein aur har feature sample data ke saath chala kar dikhayein, galat input ke saath input validation dikhayein, dikhayein ke data file se save aur load hota hai (program band karke dobara kholein), code samjhayein (aap ne kaun se structures aur functions banaye aur kyun), viva ke sawalon ke liye tayyar rahein, aur limitations aur mumkin behtariyan imaandari se batayein. Do minute ki wazahat ke chaar hisse ho sakte hain: project kya karta hai (10 seconds), main data (struct aur array), functions aur har ek kya karta hai, aur ek cheez jis par aap ko fakhar ho ya jise aap behtar karenge. Demo se pehle bad input test karein: numbers ki jagah letters, negative numbers, zero, bohat bare numbers, aur border values. Viva ke aam sawal: Yeh loop kya karta hai? Yahan pass by reference kyun use kiya? Agar file maujood na ho to kya hoga? Har team member ko code ka koi bhi hissa samjhana aana chahiye, aur instructors demo ke dauran kisi se koi chhoti cheez badalne ko keh sakte hain, masalan grade ki boundary ya menu ka ek aur option. Agar aap ko jawab nahi aata to imaandari se kahein aur batayein ke aap kya check karenge, andaza lagane ke bajaye.
